title: Word Search
description: Find the hidden words in themed letter grids by dragging across them, from easy 8×8 puzzles to tricky 12×12 ones. Free in your browser.
about:
Word Search is a relaxing puzzle where every grid hides a list of words on one theme, such as animals, space, food, music, weather or travel. Twelve themes and random placement mean that every puzzle is different. Find a word, drag across it from the first letter to the last, and it lights up in color and gets crossed off the list.

Three difficulty levels change the challenge. Easy uses an 8×8 grid with words running across or down. Medium has a 10×10 grid and adds diagonals. Hard fills a 12×12 grid with more words that can run in all eight directions, including backwards.

The timer tracks how fast you clear each grid, and your best time is saved for each difficulty.
howToPlay: Look for the words in the list inside the letter grid. Press on the first letter of a word and drag to the last letter, then release. If the word is correct it stays highlighted and is crossed off. Find every word to finish the puzzle.

controls.action: Select a word from first to last letter

tips: Scan for rare letters such as Q, X, Z or J: they make words easier to spot.
Look for the first two letters of a word next to each other.
On Hard, remember that words can run backwards and diagonally.
Start with the longest words: they are often the easiest to see.

faq.question: Is Word Search free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Word Search is free and runs in your browser, with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Drag your finger across the letters to select a word. In portrait the word list sits under the grid, in landscape beside it.

faq.question: How many themes are there?
faq.answer: Twelve: animals, food, space, sports, nature, ocean, music, weather, jobs, fruits, colors and travel, with a random theme in every puzzle.
